title: 第25章 苍瞳第26章 即将碎裂的屏障
content_zh:
;;
克洛伊脚步一踏，无数尖锐的冰棱应声从他脚下炸开，如同瞬间绽放的荆棘丛林，裹挟着摄人的寒意，朝着希琳立足之处疯狂蔓延突刺。
希琳从震惊中回过神来，脚下魔力爆发，身形如同被无形的绳索拉扯，近乎平移般闪躲开来。
但还不等她稳住身形，克洛伊的身影又如鬼魅般粘来，白色长衣下摆在他疾冲中拉出一道残影，手中雪色长枪撕裂空气，枪尖震颤，化作数十点虚实难辨的寒星所指之处，皆为她周身要害！
“锵！
锵锵锵——！”
希琳手腕急振，长剑舞成一团赤红的光轮，剑锋与枪尖在瞬息间碰撞十数次，每一次交击都炸开刺目的火星与冰屑。
巨大的力量透过剑身传来，震得她虎口发麻，脚步不由自主地向后滑退。
克洛伊的攻势如同永不停歇的海啸，枪势一转，改刺为扫！
希琳长剑斜挡，同时左手快速勾勒符文，一面燃烧着火焰的大盾瞬间成型。
“轰！”
裹着锐意寒流的长枪重重击打在盾上，火焰护盾应声炸裂，狂暴的气流将希琳狠狠掀飞出去。
她在半空中强行扭转身形，足尖在一条突兀升起的冰柱上一点，借力向后空翻，稳稳落在另一根克洛伊操控升起的冰棱之上，居高临下。
“只会躲吗，公主殿下？”
克洛伊仰头，笑意盈盈，只是在他话落瞬间，擂台地面便轰然开裂，无数粗大的冰刺如同巨兽的獠牙，朝着希琳立足的冰柱啃噬而去。
希琳没有理会他的挑衅，口中低声吟唱咒语，她抬手一握，袭来的冰刺破碎下压，克洛伊身周的空气也仿佛被瞬间抽空，巨大的重力场降临，克洛伊身形猛一滞，宛若深陷泥沼。
下一站刹那，希琳脚下冰柱崩碎，她人如离弦之箭，化作一道赤红流星俯冲而下，剑尖所指，正是克洛伊因重力场而行动迟缓的身体。
“哈……”
克洛伊一声笑，不闪不避，周身寒气疯狂四溢，在他的身前，瞬间凝出层层叠叠的冰晶壁垒，而在壁垒之后，他抬枪蓄力。
“砰！

砰！
砰！”
冰晶壁垒在剑锋下接连破碎，但每破碎一层，希琳剑上的光芒便黯淡一分。
就在剑尖击碎所有壁垒的瞬间，克洛伊手中的长枪直戳希琳面门。
希琳被迫变招，剑势一转，格开长枪。
但克洛伊仿佛早已预料，借着碰撞之力旋身，一记凌厉的鞭腿带着破空声，狠狠扫向她的腰侧！
“嘭！”
希琳只来得及用手臂格挡，一股巨力传来，整个人被扫飞出去，重重撞在擂台边缘的防护结界上，发出一声沉闷的巨响。
结界光壁剧烈荡漾。
克洛伊没有给希琳喘息机会的意思，他几乎是在将希琳击飞的瞬间同步蹿出，在希琳公主撞上结界的那一刻，他的长枪便又到了。
“咚——！”
勉力侧身，避开这奔着心脏的一枪，希琳气息紊乱地再度想要拉开距离，然而克洛伊却如若附骨之疽，半刻不离她身。
他的战斗方式毫无贵族式的优雅，只有最极致的效率与狠辣，每一次出手都瞄准关节、咽喉、眼睛等致命处，仿佛不是在决斗，而是在进行一场不死不休的厮杀。
冰系魔法与他手中的长枪完美结合，时而冻结地面限制希琳移动，时而凝聚冰枪从刁钻角度突袭，时而又化作冰雾干扰视线。
希琳凭借着远超常人的魔法掌控力和精妙剑术抗衡，火球、风刃、地刺、藤蔓……各种魔法信手拈来，与剑技配合，在擂台上掀起一阵阵元素风暴。
两人身影在擂台各处不断闪现碰撞，从地面战到半空，脚下时而借力崩碎的冰柱，时而踩踏召唤出的旋风，战斗维度彻底展开，看得人眼花缭乱。
观众席上甚至已经有很多人都是站起来在看了。
“他……竟然压着公主打？”
“那真的是克洛伊吗？”
“这打法也太凶残了，他们之间是有什么仇怨吗？”

观众的喧嚣台上的两人都听不到，他们此刻所有的感官都完全集中在对方的身上。
“嗤啦！”

As soon as Chloe stepped forward, countless sharp ice edges exploded from under his feet, like a forest of thorns that bloomed instantly, carrying a chilling chill and spreading wildly toward where Shireen stood.
Shireen recovered from the shock, magic power exploded under her feet, and her body seemed to be pulled by invisible ropes, almost moving away.
But before she could stabilize her figure, Chloe's figure clung to her like a ghost. The hem of her long white coat pulled out an afterimage as he rushed forward. The snow-colored spear in his hand tore through the air, and the tip of the spear trembled, turning into dozens of cold stars that were hard to distinguish from reality. Wherever he pointed, they were all critical parts of her body!
"Qiang!
Clang, clang, clang—! "
Shirin's wrist jerked, and the long sword danced into a ball of red light. The blade of the sword and the tip of the spear collided dozens of times in an instant, and each collision exploded into dazzling sparks and ice chips.
Huge power came through the sword, causing her jaw to go numb and her steps to slide back involuntarily.
Chloe's offensive was like a never-ending tsunami. The gun's momentum changed from stabbing to sweeping!
Shirin blocked with her long sword, and at the same time quickly sketched the runes with her left hand, a large shield burning with flames was instantly formed.
"Boom!"
The spear wrapped in a sharp cold current hit the shield hard, and the flame shield exploded, and the violent air flow violently threw Shireen away.
She forcibly twisted her body in mid-air, her toes resting on an icicle that suddenly rose up, using the force to somersault backwards, and landed firmly on another icicle raised by Chloe, condescendingly.
"Do you only know how to hide, Your Highness?"
Chloe raised her head with a smile on her face, but the moment he finished speaking, the floor of the arena suddenly cracked open, and countless thick ice spikes, like the fangs of a giant beast, gnawed away at the icicle where Shireen was standing.
Shireen ignored his provocation and chanted a spell in a low voice. She raised her hand and shook it. The incoming ice spikes shattered and pressed down. The air around Chloe seemed to be evacuated in an instant. A huge gravity field descended, and Chloe's body suddenly stagnated, as if she was stuck in a quagmire.
At the next stop, the icicles under Shirin's feet shattered. She was like an arrow from the string, turning into a red meteor and swooping down. The tip of the sword pointed at Chloe's body that was slowed down by the gravity field.
"Ha..."
Chloe laughed and did not dodge or dodge, and the cold air spread all over his body crazily. In front of him, layers of ice crystal barriers instantly formed, and behind the barrier, he raised his gun to charge up.
"Bang!
Bang!
Bang! "
The ice crystal barrier was broken one after another under the sword's edge, but with each broken layer, the light on Shirin's sword became dimmed.
At the moment when the sword tip broke all the barriers, the spear in Chloe's hand pierced Shireen's face.
Shirin was forced to change her stance, turning her sword and blocking the spear.
But Chloe seemed to have expected it. She used the force of the collision to spin around and swept her waist with a sharp whip with a sound of breaking through the air!
"Bang!"
Shirin only had time to block with her arms when a huge force came and her whole body was swept away and hit the protective barrier at the edge of the ring with a loud bang.
The barrier light wall rippled violently.
Chloe had no intention of giving Shireen a chance to breathe. He almost jumped out at the same moment as he knocked Shireen away. The moment Princess Shireen hit the barrier, his spear arrived again.
"Boom——!"
Trying to turn sideways to avoid the shot that was heading towards her heart, Shireen tried to distance herself again with a disordered breath, but Chloe was like a gangrene in her bones, refusing to leave her body for even a moment.
There is no aristocratic elegance in his fighting style, only the most extreme efficiency and ruthlessness. Every shot is aimed at the joints, throat, eyes and other fatal parts, as if he is not in a duel, but in an endless fight.
The ice magic is perfectly combined with the spear in his hand, sometimes freezing the ground to restrict Shireen's movement, sometimes condensing the ice spear to attack from tricky angles, and sometimes turning into ice mist to interfere with vision.
Shireen relies on her magical control and exquisite swordsmanship that are far beyond ordinary people.To compete, fireballs, wind blades, ground thorns, vines... all kinds of magic are at your fingertips, and combined with sword skills, set off waves of elemental storms in the ring.
The figures of the two people kept flashing and colliding all over the ring, fighting from the ground to mid-air, sometimes relying on the broken icicles under their feet, and sometimes stepping on the whirlwind summoned by stepping on them. The dimension of the battle was completely unfolded, which was dazzling.
Many people in the audience even stood up and watched.
"He... actually suppressed the princess and beat her?"
"Is that really Chloe?"
"This style of fighting is too cruel. Is there any grudge between them?"
Neither man on the stage could hear him above the din of the audience, all their senses at the moment being completely focused on each other.
"Tsk!"
